purpose: Translate Prismel's approved Elijah likeness and locked cosmic-cloak design through Prismatic HeroCel v1 without redesigning the character or weakening likeness.

likenessAuthority.subject: Elijah
identityAnchors: relaxed natural eye shape and spacing
full lips with restrained calm expression
short textured curls visible naturally inside the hood
likenessAuthority.expressionAuthority: calm, thoughtful, compassionate, determined; never blank, solemn, or generic-anime neutral
forbiddenLikenessDrift: sharpening jaw into adult or heroic angularity

characterDesignAuthority.source: approved Prismel HD+ hooded cosmic-cloak design
preserveExactly: deep navy to near-black cosmic cloak
prismatic staff when the scene or pose calls for it

organize galaxy texture into controlled larger star clusters
simplify micro-filigree only when necessary at reduced gameplay scale

face.eyeScale: light-to-moderate enlargement from Elijah's real eye shape, smaller than Kineza's young-child treatment
face.chin: soft rounded with a subtle dimple
face.nose: simplified animation planes while preserving Elijah's broader soft nose family
face.mouth: full lips, readable but restrained expression
face.skin: smooth broad cel-like value groups with minimal painterly microtexture

proportions.headRatio: slightly animation-enlarged, but clearly older/taller than Kineza

generationContract.instruction: Use Elijah likeness as face authority, Prismel HD+ hooded cosmic-cloak design as design authority, and Prismatic HeroCel v1 as rendering authority. Translate Elijah into animated Prismel; do not redesign Prismel and do not copy Kineza's face or anatomy.
